world.title: US eases Russia sanctions bill, cuts tariff threat on India and China from 500% to 100%
world.summary: US senators introduced a revised Russia sanctions bill aimed at pressuring Moscow and its significant energy buyers, including India and China. The updated legislation reduces the proposed tariff on imports from these countries from 500% to 100%. The changes reflect a strategic adjustment in the US approach to sanctions while maintaining pressure on Russia's energy sector.

world.title: Trump backs bill that could hit India with 500% tariffs over Russian oil trade
world.summary: Donald Trump has endorsed a US sanctions bill that may impose tariffs of up to 500% on countries purchasing Russian oil, potentially affecting India and China. During a discussion, he acknowledged the issue had not yet been fully addressed. This development could strain India's trade relations with the United States amid ongoing geopolitical tensions surrounding Russian oil transactions.

world.title: US, Russian astronauts launch into orbit for joint space mission
world.summary: A joint US-Russian space mission launched from Kazakhstan to the International Space Station (ISS), emphasizing collaboration amid geopolitical tensions. NASA chief Jared Isaacman attended the launch at the Baikonur Cosmodrome, where Russia’s Soyuz MS-29 spacecraft carried Russian and American astronauts. This mission underscores the enduring partnership in space exploration despite ongoing conflicts, particularly related to the Ukraine war.

business.title: Based On Tekton Launching Soon
business.summary: Nissan is set to launch a new 7-seater vehicle based on the Tekton in the Indian market. The company has experienced significant ups and downs, transitioning from successful models like the Micra, Sunny, and Terrano to setbacks with the Datsun brand. This upcoming release aims to revitalize Nissan's presence in India, moving forward from previous challenges.

business.title: Stocks to Watch Today: Ather Energy, Belrise Industries, PDS, Kirloskar Brothers, Kusumgar, IOL Chemicals, Delhivery, L&T Technology in focus on 15 July
business.summary: Stocks to watch on July 15 include L&T Technology Services, Tata Elxsi, Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers, Ather Energy, Belrise Industries, PDS, Kirloskar Brothers, Easy Trip Planners, and IOL Chemicals and Pharmaceuticals. Investors should monitor these companies for potential market movements, significant investments, quarterly earnings, and other major developments impacting their stock performance on this date.

business.title: Maharashtra FDA suspends licences of 3 Mumbai restaurants over hygiene lapses
business.summary: The Maharashtra Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has suspended the food business licences of three prominent Mumbai restaurants due to hygiene violations. This action follows the recent closure of the K Rustom ice cream parlour, where inspections revealed the presence of rats, flies, and expired flavouring agents. The FDA continues to enforce food safety regulations in the region.

technology.title: Spotify brings chatbot-powered music discovery
technology.summary: Spotify has introduced a new feature called "Talk to Spotify," allowing Premium subscribers to engage with the service through natural conversations. This chatbot-powered music discovery tool utilizes artificial intelligence to enhance user interaction, enabling personalized recommendations and improved navigation. Currently in beta, the feature aims to streamline the music discovery process for users seeking tailored listening experiences.

technology.title: PlayStation's Social Feeds Are Still on Fire
technology.summary: Sony's decision to discontinue physical disc production for PlayStation has sparked significant backlash on social media, with thousands of comments flooding its channels. Analysts suggest that the company's shift towards digital profits makes a reversal of this decision unlikely. Developers are finding their promotional efforts overshadowed by the ongoing discourse surrounding the discontinuation of Blu-ray discs.

technology.title: PlayStation's FlexStrike Wireless Fight Stick Postponed Due to "Unexpected Production Delays"
technology.summary: PlayStation has postponed the release of its FlexStrike wireless fight stick due to unexpected production delays. The announcement was made on July 14, 2026, via the company's official blog. The new launch date has not yet been determined. The delay affects the availability of the product, which is designed for fighting game enthusiasts. Further updates are anticipated.

sports.title: France vs Spain, FIFA World Cup semifinal LIVE: Porro scores as Spain goes 2-0 up
sports.summary: Spain is leading France 2-0 in the FIFA World Cup semifinal at AT&T Stadium in Arlington on July 14, 2026. Porro scored the second goal for Spain. France has made changes to their lineup, recalling Bradley Barcola in attack and Aurelien Tchouameni in midfield. The match is being covered live by The Hindu.

sports.title: Tottenham demand €50m for Romero, too expensive for Inter
sports.summary: Tottenham Hotspur are requesting €50 million for defender Cristian Romero, according to Sportitalia. This price tag makes it unlikely that Inter Milan will secure his transfer, as they face competition from Barcelona. The situation was further detailed by Fabrizio Romano on his YouTube channel, highlighting the financial challenges Inter may encounter in pursuing Romero.

sports.title: Shubman Gill's 80, Axar-Washington stand give India 1-0 lead over England in ODI series
sports.summary: Shubman Gill scored 80 runs as India secured a six-wicket victory over England in the first ODI at Edgbaston on Tuesday. This win gives India a 1-0 lead in the three-match series. Gill's performance continued his strong record at the venue, contributing significantly to India's successful chase and setting a positive tone for the series ahead.

health.title: IMA issues diectives on Chandipura virus in Gujarat
health.summary: The Gujarat State Branch of the Indian Medical Association (GSB-IMA) has issued an advisory regarding the Chandipura virus, urging pediatricians to review children's medical histories and symptoms, including high fever and convulsions. This directive follows three reported deaths linked to the virus. The organization emphasized the need for strict preventive measures to curb the spread of this sandfly-borne pathogen.

health.title: FDA's Traceback Endeavor: Tackling Cyclosporiasis Outbreak
health.summary: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) is investigating several produce items to trace the source of a cyclosporiasis outbreak. This intestinal infection is typically contracted through contaminated raw fruits and vegetables. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention highlights the risks associated with consuming contaminated produce, prompting the FDA's efforts to ensure food safety.

health.title: There's one reason why so many cold and flu tablets don't actually work
health.summary: Many Australians use cold and flu tablets to alleviate symptoms like runny noses and sinus congestion, expecting quick relief. However, many of these medications may not be effective. The article explores the reasons behind the ineffectiveness of numerous cold and flu remedies, highlighting that they often do not deliver the promised benefits for treating common cold symptoms.

science.title: Scientists use sound waves to create protective crystal coatings on crops
science.summary: Researchers at RMIT University have developed a method using high-frequency sound waves to spray protective crystal coatings onto plant leaves. This innovative technique creates a fine mist that forms crystal layers on delicate surfaces, enhancing crop protection. The sound-wave coating system offers a safe and effective way to shield living plants, potentially improving agricultural practices and crop resilience.

science.title: Earliest galaxies were well organised less than a billion years after Big Bang, reveals IUCAA study
science.summary: A study by IUCAA utilizing the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) has discovered spheroidal galaxies formed 400 to 900 million years after the Big Bang that exhibit the Kormendy relation. This finding indicates that early galaxies were already well organized, challenging previous assumptions about the structure and development of galaxies in the universe's formative years.

science.title: A new fabrication technique for the ultra-clean manufacturing of 2D heterostructures
science.summary: Researchers have developed a new fabrication technique for the ultra-clean manufacturing of 2D heterostructures. This method is expected to facilitate the creation of next-generation devices, potentially accelerating advancements in quantum computing. The innovation aims to enhance the quality and performance of materials used in various applications, contributing to the ongoing research and development in the field of quantum technologies.

entertainment.title: Aamir Khan faces fatwa after marrying Gauri Spratt; cleric objects to interfaith marriage: 'Gair Muslim se shaadi karna haraam hai'
entertainment.summary: Aamir Khan is facing backlash following his marriage to Gauri Spratt, as a Muslim cleric has issued a fatwa against their interfaith union. The cleric argues that marrying outside the faith is forbidden under Islamic law. This controversy arises shortly after the couple's wedding, highlighting ongoing tensions surrounding interfaith relationships within certain religious communities.

entertainment.title: Ayodhya priest's remark sparks uproar
entertainment.summary: A religious leader has offered a Rs 5 crore reward for the killing of actor Aamir Khan, following backlash over his marriage to Gauri Spratt. The situation escalated with protests, effigy burnings, and allegations of "love jihad" from members of the Bajrang Dal. Khan has faced increasing hostility since the announcement of his marriage.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: Daily astrological predictions for July 15, 2026
entertainment.summary: Horoscope predictions for July 15, 2026, provide insights into the astrological influences affecting each of the 12 zodiac signs. The analysis includes the movements of planets and their alignments, offering guidance on how these celestial events may impact individuals. Readers can access tailored forecasts to understand better the potential effects on their daily lives and decisions.
